6/S0.subgoal: Explain the four historical phases of the evolution of virtual reality.

6/S1.subgoal: Describe the key developments in the early era before the advent of computers.

6/S2.subgoal: Describe the key developments during the formative years of virtual reality (1950-1990).

6/S3.subgoal: Describe the key developments during the modern phase of virtual reality (1991-2015).

6/S4.subgoal: Describe the developments in the growth phase and summarize the historical evolution of the field.
